correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md uses unsigned incidence B of K_n minus t pairwise disjoint edges and the exact identity L(line graph)=diag(d_u+d_v)-B^T B. Its rational determinant reduces to pair-difference, pair-constant, unpaired-vertex difference, and two-dimensional quotient subspaces, giving the polynomial in U,V,W,Q. Exact factor cancellations at t=1,r=1,r=2 avoid false spectral poles; t=0 and r=0 handled separately. For t>=2,0<r, discriminant (n-3)^2+8(t-1) lies between nearby squares with parity exclusion; for t=1,n>=5 the W discriminant (n-3)^2+8 is nonsquare. Thus Laplacian integral iff t=0 or 2t=n or (n,t)=(4,1). Independent symbolic line-graph characteristic polynomials matched 14 legal n,t pairs (n=4..7).
